description: A radar chart comparing products in Svelte 5. type radar plots each category, speed, quality, price, durability, ergonomics and warranty, as a spoke, and every series draws a polygon connecting its values across the spokes on a shared scale, so two products read against each other directly. Click the legend to isolate one, and filter the grid to change which products are plotted.

faq.question: How is the scale chosen?
faq.answer: All spokes share one scale from zero to the maximum value across every series, so the polygons are comparable; normalise your columns to the same range first if their units differ.

faq.question: How are categories ordered?
faq.answer: In the order of the categories array, clockwise from the top; reorder the array to put related attributes next to each other.

faq.question: How many series are practical?
faq.answer: Three or four polygons stay readable; beyond that use the legend to isolate one at a time, which a click does.
